problem: Production pricing interaction readback timed out before any click because the page never exposed the ready-v3 readiness contract within 20 seconds.
root_cause: The canonical pricing handlers were initialized inline in prijzen.html, but the ready-v3 marker was owned only by the deferred pricing-interactions-rescue-v1.js asset. Production correctness therefore depended on a secondary rescue asset executing even though the primary inline runtime had already initialized the controls.
fix: Make the primary inline pricing runtime publish ready-v3 after billing/group/stage initialization.
Publish initial stage, group and billing state from the same authority.
Keep the rescue asset as a resilience layer rather than the sole readiness authority.
Add a regression test proving the inline source owns the readiness contract.
prevention_rule: A production readiness marker must be emitted by the same canonical runtime that establishes the behavior being verified. Rescue/fallback assets may reinforce state but must not be the sole authority for readiness.

invariants: the primary pricing runtime emits ready-v3 only after initial stage/group/billing state is established
loss-stage control remains present and fail-closed when absent
rescue runtime remains additive rather than authoritative
production verifier continues to require real interaction postconditions
